MPs Speaking:Dr Goh Keng Swee (Minister for Finance); Dr Toh Chin Chye (Deputy Prime Minister and Leader of the House); Mr Lee Kuan Yew (Prime Minister); Mr Ong Pang Boon (Minister for Home Affairs and Acting Minister for Labour); Mr S. Column: 375

INTERNAL SECURITY COUNCIL'S
DECISION AND STATEMENT ON
COMMUNIST CONSPIRACY


    Mrs Seow Peck Leng: Mr Deputy Speaker, Sir, I think we have no quorum. There are about six or seven of us here.

Column: 455



    Notice taken that thirteen Members were not present, Members summoned as if for a division pursuant to the Standing Order, and meeting resumed upon a quorum being then present.

    Mr Deputy Speaker: I must ask both the Government side and the Opposition side to see that at least thirteen Members remain in the Chamber so that we can finish the debate as quickly as possible. Dr Lee.
